info.title: Traigent Content-less Best-config Head Routes
info.description: Ref-addressed agent-head read of the content-less optimization channel (plan v2.1 phase 0b). The protected-publish precondition (headers X-Traigent-Agent-Ref and X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation) is declared on POST /api/v1/best-configs in execution/best_config_endpoints.json; its rule and closed refusals are specified there.

get.summary: Read an agent's promotion head by its opaque ref
get.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/best_config_routes.py get_agent_head_by_ref. Resolves `agent_ref` (optimization_identity.resolve_ref, kind agent) inside the caller's tenant and project, keeps agent READ authorization, and returns the head generation (0 / exists=false when never promoted; invariant exists <=> generation >= 1). A run captures this generation when it STARTS and sends it as X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation when it publishes its own result; a stale refusal is never cured by re-reading the head and resubmitting the same result. ORDER OF REFUSALS: (1) unauthenticated 401 / forbidden 403 (permissions); (2) malformed path ref or `environment` outside the closed enum: 400 head_capture_invalid; (3) well-formed but unknown, foreign or unreadable ref: 404 reference_not_found, nothing echoed. Every error body of this route is the closed envelope best_config_head_refusal_schema.json except 429 (rate_limit_info).

200.description: The head generation for the agent and environment.

400.description: head_capture_invalid — malformed `agent_ref` path value or `environment` outside the closed enum. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated — closed envelope with fixed text.

403.description: forbidden — caller lacks experiment.read or the project role. Closed envelope with fixed text. (A caller who may not READ the agent gets 404 reference_not_found, never a distinguishable denial.)

404.description: reference_not_found — the well-formed ref is unknown, foreign, no longer visible or not readable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: internal_error — closed envelope with fixed text; no exception data.
